about: Data size budgets for the website and the app (owner, 2026-11-19: slow pages came from downloading and parsing big data files whole). The one place budgets live: scripts/split-data.ts cuts parts to them, src/lib/data-budgets.test.ts (website) and App/src/__tests__/data-budgets.test.ts (app) fail when a first-load file or a page's first load is over, and scripts/load-scan reads them for the browser scan. Sizes are gzip at gzipLevel (what a phone downloads) and raw (what it parses).

overBudget.why: The whole question bank (every question with its answers and sources, 16 MB raw), read whole by the Questions pages before the first question shows.
overBudget.plan: Split it with scripts/split-data.ts: an index of categories and counts first, each category's questions when it is chosen, search text on search (follow-up job).
